Equivalent weight of \(\textit{Ag}\) =\(\cfrac{108}{1} =108\)

Equivalent weight of \(\textit{Cu }\)\(=\cfrac{63.6}{2} =31.8\)

Number of equivalents of silver formed = Number of equivalents of copper formed.

\[\cfrac{M_{1} }{M_{2} } =\cfrac{E_{1} }{E_{2} } \]

\[\cfrac{10.79}{M_{Cu} } =\cfrac{108}{31.8} \]

\[M_{Cu} =\cfrac{10.79\times 31.8}{108} =3.2\; gm.\]
